```mermaid
flowchart LR
    LEGACY["Legacy Model: ThinkingStorm US ($45/hr)"] -->|Outsources to| TRIVIUM["Trivium India ($8/hr)"] -->|Pays Indian Reviewer| SWEATSHOP["Reviewer (₹150-200/hr) • 48-72h SLA"]
    
    APEX_MODEL["Apex Direct Architecture"] -->|Direct Retainer: $1,500-$2,500/mo| APEX_DESK["Apex Autonomous Review Desk"]
    APEX_DESK -->|Instant UPI Payout: ₹600/hr (₹450/essay)| ELITE_BENCH["Elite DU / JNU Scholars • Sub-6-Hour SLA"]
```

* **Client Advantage:** US/Global Admissions consultancies cut their overflow editing expenses by **40%–60%** while gaining guaranteed sub-6-hour turnaround and native Word OpenXML track changes.
* **Reviewer Advantage:** Indian academic writing fellows earn **$7.20 USD / hr (₹600/hr)** with instant UPI settlement, compared to ₹150–200/hr at legacy Indian outsourcing firms.
* **Apex Advantage:** Blended gross margin consistently exceeds **88.5%**, generating substantial cash flow without inventory risk or heavy capex.

## 💼 4. Working Capital & Payout Treasury Policy
1. **Client Inflow:** 100% upfront billing via Stripe credit card / ACH wire before service delivery. Net 0 credit risk.
2. **Reviewer Outflow:** Disbursed via UPI to vetted Indian reviewers upon passing cryptographic SHA-256 QA certification.
3. **Cash Reserve:** Minimum 60-day operational runway maintained in liquid USD/INR accounts.
